sources.quote: A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora has been conditional since 2026-09-15 (it replaced the approved QS-D-2022). Placing new HB-620 orders with it is new business that QP-11 4.3 does not allow.

sources.quote: Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The statement that Dora is still on the approved list is outdated. APR-009 was superseded by APR-010, which revoked the approval on 2026-09-15. No current approval exists for Dora, HB-620, PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR. The current approved source is Fonderia Pellice (APR-011).

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3), three escapes to the Nordhavn line.

findings.why: Dora has an open 8D on porosity in the AlSi9Cu3 castings of HB-620. This is the same material and part as the proposed order.
